### List

```go
func (s *GroupService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[GroupAccount]], error)
```

List the groups of the host.

Lists each group with its ID and its members, by name, from /etc/group through
gohai, on every platform. The members are the users that /etc/group names; a
user whose primary group it is is not listed again.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/group`, and needs the permission
`group:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host with a group, `go run group.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.List(ctx, target)
```

### Create

```go
func (s *GroupService) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input GroupCreateInput,
) (*Response[Collection[GroupResult]], error)
```

Add a group.

Adds the group with groupadd, with the ID when one is given. A group that the
host has already does not change and reports changed: false, whatever its ID. It
runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/group`, and needs the permission
`group:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Add a group, `go run group.go create`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.Create(ctx, target, client.GroupCreateInput{Name: "osapitest"})
```

Add a system group with its ID, `go run group.go create-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.Create(ctx, target, client.GroupCreateInput{
	GID:    1999,
	Name:   "osapitest",
	System: true,
})
```

### Get

```go
func (s *GroupService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	name string,
) (*Response[Collection[GroupAccount]], error)
```

Get one group.

Reads one group from the same list. A group that the host does not have is not
found.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/group/{name}`, and needs the permission
`group:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A group, `go run group.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.Get(ctx, target, "developers")
```

### Update

```go
func (s *GroupService) Update(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input GroupUpdateInput,
) (*Response[Collection[GroupResult]], error)
```

Set the members of a group.

Sets the members with gpasswd -M, in place of the members that the group has.
The same members, in any order, do not change it and report changed: false. A
group that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family
only, and elsewhere reports skipped.

It sends `PUT /api/node/{hostname}/group/{name}`, and needs the permission
`group:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Set the members, `go run group.go update`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.Update(ctx, target, client.GroupUpdateInput{
	Members: []string{"root"},
	Name:    "osapitest",
})
```

func (s *GroupService) Delete(

Remove a group.

Removes the group with groupdel. A group that the host does not have does not
change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian family only, and
elsewhere reports skipped.

It sends `DELETE /api/node/{hostname}/group/{name}`, and needs the permission
`group:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Remove a group, `go run group.go delete`:

```go
resp, err := c.Group.Delete(ctx, target, "osapitest")
```
